/api/dashboards:
    get:
      description: Returns a paginated list of dashboards. Each result includes title, description, tags, and metadata, but not the full panel layout. Use `GET /api/dashboards/{id}` to retrieve the complete state.
      operationId: get-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: The page of results to return.
          in: query
          name: page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 1
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: The number of results to return per page.
          in: query
          name: per_page
          required: false
          schema:
            default: 20
            maximum: 1000
            minimum: 1
            type: number
        - description: Filters results by `title` and `description` using Elasticsearch [`simple_query_string`](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/query-languages/query-dsl/query-dsl-simple-query-string-query) syntax. Multi-word terms require all words to match.
          in: query
          name: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - description: A tag ID to include. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are included.
          in: query
          name: tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag ID to exclude. Accepts a single tag ID or multiple tag IDs. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag IDs are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tags
          required: false
          schema:
            default: []
            description: Tag IDs associated with this dashboard.
            items:
              maxLength: 250
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
        - description: A tag name to include. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are included. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are included.
          in: query
          name: tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
        - description: A tag name to exclude. Accepts a single tag name or multiple tag names. When multiple are specified, library items matching any of the tag names are excluded. If the same name is shared by multiple tags, items matching any of those tags are excluded.
          in: query
          name: excluded_tag_names
          required: false
          schema:
            items:
              type: string
            maxItems: 100
            type: array
            x-state: Generally available; added in 9.6.0
      responses:
        '200':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                searchDashboardsResponse:
                  description: |
                    Paginated list of dashboard summaries. Each item includes the ID, a subset of dashboard state fields (`title`, `time_range` if set), and metadata. Full panel content is not included - use the GET endpoint to retrieve a specific dashboard.
                  summary: Search dashboards response
                  value:
                    data:
                      - data:
                          title: Web logs overview
                        id: 3c4b8e10-d57a-11ef-9a52-4f3c2a8d0e1b
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMiwxXQ==
                      - data:
                          time_range:
                            from: now-7d
                            to: now
                          title: Operations overview
                        id: 7f2a1c40-e83b-11ef-a641-7d5b3f9e1c2a
                        meta:
                          created_at: '2026-04-12T08:00:00.000Z'
                          managed: false
                          updated_at: '2026-04-12T14:22:00.000Z'
                          version: WzEwMSwxXQ==
                    meta:
                      page: 1
                      per_page: 20

post:
      description: Creates a new dashboard and returns its ID, full state, and metadata.
      operationId: post-dashboards
      parameters:
        - description: A required header to protect against CSRF attacks
          in: header
          name: kbn-xsrf
          required: true
          schema:
            example: 'true'
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_kbn-dashboard-data'
      responses:
        '201':
          content:
            application/json:
              examples:
                createDashboardResponse:
                  description: |
                    Response to creating a dashboard. Returns the generated ID, the full dashboard state in `data`, and metadata. Default option values are always returned even when not explicitly set in the request. Panel `id` values are generated automatically.
                  summary: Create dashboard response
                  value:
                    data:
                      access_control:
                        access_mode: write_restricted
                      options:
                        auto_apply_filters: true
                        hide_panel_borders: false
                        hide_panel_titles: false
                        sync_colors: false
                        sync_cursor: true
                        sync_tooltips: false
                        use_margins: true
                      panels:
                        - config:
                            content: '## Web logs overview'
                          grid:
                            h: 15
                            w: 24
                            x: 0
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000001
                          type: markdown
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - empty_as_null: false
                                operation: count
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 24
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000002
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            data_source:
                              index_pattern: kibana_sample_data_logs
                              time_field: timestamp
                              type: data_view_spec
                            ignore_global_filters: false
                            metrics:
                              - field: bytes
                                operation: average
                                type: primary
                            sampling: 1
                            styling:
                              primary:
                                labels:
                                  alignment: left
                                position: bottom
                                value:
                                  alignment: right
                                  sizing: auto
                            title: ''
                            type: metric
                          grid:
                            h: 5
                            w: 12
                            x: 36
                            'y': 0
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                        - config:
                            axis:
                              x:
                                domain:
                                  rounding: false
                                  type: fit
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: ordinal
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: false
                              'y':
                                anchor: start
                                domain:
                                  rounding: true
                                  type: full
                                grid:
                                  visible: true
                                labels:
                                  orientation: horizontal
                                scale: linear
                                ticks:
                                  visible: true
                                title:
                                  visible: true
                            layers:
                              - data_source:
                                  query: FROM kibana_sample_data_logs | STATS count = COUNT() BY BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                  type: esql
                                ignore_global_filters: false
                                sampling: 1
                                type: line
                                x:
                                  column: BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend)
                                'y':
                                  - axis_id: 'y'
                                    column: count
                            legend:
                              layout:
                                truncate:
                                  max_lines: 1
                                type: grid
                              placement: outside
                              position: right
                              visibility: hidden
                            styling:
                              interpolation: linear
                              overlays:
                                current_time_marker:
                                  visible: false
                                partial_buckets:
                                  visible: false
                              points:
                                visibility: auto
                            title: Requests over time
                            type: xy
                          grid:
                            h: 10
                            w: 24
                            x: 24
                            'y': 5
                          id: a1b2c3d4-0001-4000-8000-000000000003
                          type: vis
                      pinned_panels: []
                      title: Web logs overview
                    id: 3c4b8e10-d57a-11ef-9a52-4f3c2a8d0e1b
                    meta:
                      created_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                      managed: false
                      updated_at: '2026-04-13T10:00:00.000Z'
                      version: WzEwMiwxXQ==
              schema:

content.text:
The dashboard and the alert rule both exist, and the rule is enabled. I didn't open the dashboard in Kibana or wait for the rule's first run, so I haven't seen either work.

**Data view fields:** The data view `kibana_sample_data_logs` has a `timestamp` field for time. Its other main fields are:
- Traffic: `bytes`, `clientip`, `request`, `url`, `extension`, `referer`, `host` and `agent`.
- Geography: `geo.src`, `geo.dest` and `geo.coordinates`.
- Client details: `machine.os`, `machine.ram`, `memory` and `phpmemory`.
- Status: `response` is a text field holding the status code, and `response.keyword` is its aggregatable version.

**Dashboard:** "EFF-7da5aea9 Web logs overview" (id `3d4cce89-96b7-42b9-b99a-97fad644b280`) has four panels and defaults to the last 7 days:
- Total requests
- Average bytes
- Unique clients
- A line chart of requests over time

**Alert rule:** "EFF-7da5aea9 5xx spike" (id `9c837833-ff2c-46f2-98af-23bd11c41dbe`) is an Elasticsearch query rule on `kibana_sample_data_logs` that runs every minute. It counts documents where `response.keyword` starts with "5" and fires when the count over the last 5 minutes is above 10. It has no actions attached, so it will show up as an active alert in Kibana but won't send any notification.

The first dashboard create call failed because the line chart used an ES|QL data source the API rejected. I rebuilt that panel on the data view and the retry succeeded, so only one dashboard was created.
